S01.basis: WQX condition Not Detected + numeric reporting limit; condition and limit support a left-censored observation.

S02.basis: WQX DL documents non-detection, but no threshold is present; status records refusal rather than inventing a bound.

S03.basis: Present Below Quantification Limit is excluded by the default below-LOQ policy.

S04.basis: J/estimated result is not treated as an exact detected value under the default policy.

S05.basis: LOQ role is not in the reporting-only censoring roles; role is retained.

S06.basis: ng/L converts to ug/L by 0.001; detected value is eligible.

S07.basis: Unknown limit type is not forced into a reporting role; refusal is explicit.

S08.basis: Embedded < and coded > disagree; no precedence is invented.

S09.basis: Quality-control activity is excluded from routine environmental samples.

S10.basis: Field Msr/Obs is treated as a non-routine activity and retained under the excluded_qc branch; status_detail identifies the activity, so this is not a claim that every field measurement is a QC sample.

S11.basis: Target fraction is Total under the default policy.

S12.basis: Exact detected numeric result; no limit needed.

S13.basis: Right-censored result is outside the left-censored analysis input; raw qualifier retained.

S14.basis: ResultValueTypeName Other is not an actual result under the default policy.

S15.basis: Detected condition without a numeric value is unresolved, not filled.
